label: Baseball

criteria.label: Arm extension
criteria.look_for: arms extending through the zone, hands inside the ball
criteria.drill: Tee work: finish with both arms extended toward the pitcher.

criteria.label: Posture
criteria.look_for: athletic tilt, head still, no lunging
criteria.drill: Mirror swings, check the tilt stays constant.

criteria.label: Base
criteria.look_for: stable flexed base, weight moving to the front side
criteria.drill: Stride-and-stop drill: land balanced before swinging.

criteria.label: Hip rotation
criteria.look_for: hips opening ahead of the hands
criteria.drill: Hip-lead drill with a med ball.

camera_angles.label: Side view
camera_angles.description: Camera at 90 degrees to the action. Best for arm extension and lean.

camera_angles.label: Front view
camera_angles.description: Camera facing the athlete. Best for balance and knee alignment.

coaching_note: Judge the swing: stance, load, stride, contact, finish.
